function _deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver, uint256 minShares) private nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) { require(assets > 0, "zero deposit"); require(receiver != address(0), "zero receiver"); uint256 assetsBefore = totalAssets(); if (depositCap > 0) require(assetsBefore + assets <= depositCap, "exceeds deposit cap"); _pull(assets); uint256 received = totalAssets() - assetsBefore; shares = (received * (totalSupply + SHARE_OFFSET)) / (assetsBefore + 1); require(shares > 0, "zero shares"); require(shares >= minShares, "slippage exceeded"); totalSupply += shares; balanceOf[receiver] += shares; costBasisOf[receiver] += received; emit Deposit(msg.sender, receiver, received, shares); }
